title: Warm-up 1: The Cave
text: A cave is a ring with a locked door at the far side. Peggy says she knows the word that opens it. Victor wants proof, and Peggy won't say the word.
held: Victor is a little more convinced, and knows nothing about the word.

cards.label: Walk in by a path Victor can't see
Tell Victor the word so he can try it
cards.why: That proves it, and gives the secret away. The point is to convince him while he learns nothing.

cards.label: Call out a side at random: “come out on the left”
Ask which way she went in, and tell her to come back the same way
cards.why: She can do that without the word. The challenge has to be one she could only meet half the time by luck.

cards.label: Come out on the left, opening the door if you need to
Come out on whichever side you went in
cards.why: Half the time that is the wrong side. Only someone who can open the door can always come out where asked.
